local sanity of the two-outlet oracle before the probe, seed 1 (float64): with the region's tree and its paths given to the wall as two solids, the solid carried 7 times the lumen's flux (each solid's resistivity filled the other's lumen) while the split still met the network to 8e-4 (the laws' resistances dominate it), and the name-patch swap moved it by 1e-3: the split alone cannot see either, so the gate gains the daughters' own lumen flux (lumen_split); with the two joined as one solid the lumen carries 92 % of the inflow on that draw (the wide box's solid the rest), the dropped plant moved the split by 0.186

the same draw (seed 1) with one joined solid at the default stiff interior 0.1h: the daughters' lumens carry 0.413 and 0.449 of the inflow while the openings report 0.255 and 0.745 (the laws' split, 0.257 by the network): the solid between the two ends' patches on their shared plane carries the difference (#246's limit (ii), here large: the laws' resistances are 20 to 50 times the branches', so the branches' pressure drops are small against what the solid needs to carry it). The gate's rig moves to the stiff interior 0.01h (the solid's conductance a hundredth), the default's exchange re-measured as #246's limit

seed 1 with the exchange read beyond the band's half width: 0.467 and 0.320 of the ends' fluxes at 0.1h (line 0.073), 0.0133 and 0.0127 at 0.01h (line 0.0079): the flag fires at both; the exchange falls 35 times

the first probe (run 43050574164, probe/f2b4a-gates at 4d99de3), before this rerun: the two-outlet split within 1.8e-3 of the network on 40 float64 draws (tilts 0.06 to 19.8 degrees), dropped 40/40, swapped 40/40, the distal discriminator 1.7e-15; but 2 of 40 clean draws past the lumen line (0.106, 0.082), the measuring disc of one daughter reaching the other where they lie within its reach at its plane (seed 27: 0.99 mm apart against 1.12 mm); the watch's near and far arms crashed (a run not a whole number of chunks) and the crash counted as caught; the reversing arm read the watch 0 while outward on 6/6 but backflow_flagged and the ledger's gift on 6/6 (the explicit term's sign at the transitions); FB9's asymmetry 0.26, 0.26, 0.105, 0.062 at extensions 0.25, 0.75, 2 and 4 D, the centreline 0.70 to 0.77 of 2U; #246's limits on seeds 0 and 1 (the runner stopped after): the root's solid share 15.6 % and 6.2 % in steady flow at 0.1h, -4 to 35 % and 3 to 103 % pulsed at omega (delta_in h)^2/nu 0.01 and 0.3, the closed valve's net 1e-16 with its patch's faces carrying 29 to 49 % of the inflow gross. gate_two_outlet_tree.claim: scope item 0: the shared distal law across a tube tree's two ends, on unequal branches and a vessel aligned with no grid axis, splits the inflow as the 0-D network of its branches (Poiseuille from the junction along each daughter, its extension, bend and run, in series with the law's own resistance), the distal resistance dropping out; and the opening named end_0 carries the flow of the daughter that leads to end_0 (its lumen's flux read from the geometry, not from any opening)
gate_two_outlet_tree.kind: acceptance (the network's branch resistances are Poiseuille's, so the line bounds the wiring and the block's solve, not the band's offset)

prediction.unit: |split - network|, a share of the inflow
prediction.why: the branches are 1/20 to 1/50 of their laws' resistances, so the band's offset (+10.8 % of a branch's flux at 8 cells across, more at 6) and the junction's loss move the split by at most about 0.1 x 1/20 of a branch's share

lumen.why: the solid's bypass in proportion to each daughter cancels in the share; what is left is its unequal part and the plane's sampling of an oblique section

gate_two_outlet_tree.metric: |split - network| (line 0.01) and |lumen - split| (line 0.05), lumen the end_0 daughter's share of the two daughters' lumen flux through a z plane 0.6 of the way along each

control.plant: dropped: the law's off-diagonals dropped, each R_d in its own row (the split moves toward a half by R_d's share: 0.05 to 0.2 on these draws); swapped: the two ends' patches exchanged (OpeningLayout.masks' rows), a name-patch mix-up: the split barely moves (the laws dominate it) and the lumen share moves to about the split's complement, 0.3 to 0.6 away

gate_two_outlet_tree.discriminator: the distal resistance times ten alone: the split moves by under 100 solve tolerances (it drops out exactly in the network and in the field: both outlets see one distal pressure)
gate_two_outlet_tree.tilted: every draw turns the tree from z (0 to 20 degrees) about a drawn axis, its offset part of a cell: the tilted vessel's gate ('F2's rows, 4', item 5); its own CI case a straight tube 23 degrees off z (test_fvm_region.py)
gate_two_outlet_tree.cannot_discriminate_if: the two laws' resistances equal (a split of a half is its own complement under the swap): the draws keep their ratio from 2 to 4

gate_backflow_sign.claim: R-15: the backflow term's booked work is never positive beyond its rounding on correct runs (backflow_flagged zero, the ledger's gift count for <node>.backflow zero), and a term of the wrong sign is flagged on every run
gate_backflow_sign.case: the outlet watch's runs below (convection on, a reversing outlet), and region_cases' draws (the solid's faces' Darcy inflow)

prediction.why: f . u' = min(w, 0) w w' / h <= 0 while w and w' share a sign; a face turning outward within a step is the term's known exception, which a correct steady or slowly varying run does not reach

control.plant: the term's sign flipped (it pushes the inflow in)
control.expected_rate: every run with an inward face at an outlet

gate_fb8_watch.claim: FB8: the outlet watch fires with its plane 0.5 D after a stenosis's throat (in its recirculation), and stays silent with the plane moved on by an extension of 8 D; with a reversing inflow at low Womersley number it stays silent while the net flux through the outlet is outward and reads nothing while it is inward; it reports the backflow term's booked work beside the port's
gate_fb8_watch.case: region_cases.watch_reading(seed, arm): a straight vessel along z (D 1 mm) narrowing to 0.6 of its diameter over 0.5 D and widening back over 0.25 D, its end 0.5 D after the throat, the extension 0 (near) or 8 D (far); IMEX Euler, convection on, a steady inflow at Re 100 (near, far) or Q(t) = Q_m (1 + 1.5 sin wt) at Re 20 and alpha 0.5 (reversing), D/h 8

near.unit: the largest reversed share over the run's second half

reversing.unit: the largest reversed share while the net flux is outward

prediction.basis: guess (no recirculation behind this stenosis was measured before)
prediction.why: a jet at 2.8 times the mean speed leaves the throat into an expansion of 1.67 in diameter: at Re 100 its separated annulus reaches past 0.5 D; by 8.5 D the flow has reattached; at alpha 0.5 the profile reverses whole, so no face turns inward while the net flux is outward

gate_fb8_watch.line: placed between the far and reversing arms' largest and the near arm's least, at the geometric mean of the two, from these measurements; REVERSAL_LINE until then 0.05 (declared)

control.plant: the plane moved to 0.5 D after the throat (the near arm)
control.expected_rate: every draw of the near arm fires (draws in Re 80 to 120, the throat 0.55 to 0.65 of D, sub-cell offsets)

gate_fb8_watch.if_wrong: a near arm that does not fire means no recirculation reaches the plane at this Re and throat (the backflow term damps what the plane sees): report its share and raise Re or narrow the throat, saying so
